about: English specs and build status of the decided changes that are built, by decision-page row. tools/build_list.py merges this into docs/build-list.json. A part is todo until built, done when built, lab-checked once a disposable lab install checked it (docs/evidence), later when it is only a possible later change on Christopher's list.

parts.spec: Stays vanilla, with one fix: casting Spirit Armor again on a creature that has it replaces the earlier casting, so its +3 to saves vs. spell and its expiry damage no longer stack. Mage Armor and Ghost Armor need nothing: all three set the base AC and the best one counts.

Minor Spell Deflection stops only spells of levels 1-4 (vanilla: 1-7, so a level-3 spell also absorbed Breach and priest spells up to level 7). Its description says so. The rest of the Spell Deflection and Spell Turning line stays vanilla.
Later: look at Spell Turning's reflection, and whether Minor Spell Deflection stays fully vanilla after all.

Spiders (race SPIDER) and amorphous creatures (race SLIME: slimes, jellies, oozes, puddings) are immune.
Dragons and the very obvious flying and incorporeal creatures are immune, by race: DRAGON; WYVERN, BEHOLDER, MEPHIT; SPECTRE, WRAITH, SHADOW, MIST. Giants and ettins are not.

Maybe other creatures: imps and quasits, genies, devas and planetars, bats, birds and will-o'-wisps (no race of their own), golems, big elementals. Fire elementals burn, so a web holding them makes little sense.
Web may be too strong in the base game; its -2 stays for now.
An idea, far off: webs that can catch fire, but not easily, say from someone standing in one with a fire shield for a round or two. It needs a mechanic of its own first.
Smaller radius (maybe, like SR); school Conjuration.

parts.spec: Fireball, Delayed Blast Fireball, Sunfire, Cone of Cold, Flame Strike, Skull Trap, Glyph of Warding, Incendiary Cloud and Lightning Bolt: the damage allows a save vs. breath instead of vs. spell, without extra penalties; the damage stays. Descriptions that named the save say so. Chain Lightning, mind and transmutation spells keep save vs. spell.
Meteor Swarm and Fire Storm have no save at all in the base game and stay that way for now; a save vs. breath is on the list of possible later changes.
Sleep, Color Spray, Stinking Cloud, Power Word: Sleep, Command, Greater Command and Emotion: Hopelessness: damage ends the sleep.
The IWD spells that put creatures to sleep or knock them out get the same when they are built.
Not together with Spell Revisions: the README says so and the installer warns plainly and carries on. No work goes into making them fit.
Declare the two incompatible outright at some later step.
At some later step: when installed after SCS, Chriz BG Magic may overwrite SCS's changes.
